Hi Oleg,

When Higgsfield (https://dxszHp04.na2.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/DR+113/dxszHp04/VX30kJ5gp615W1wW6Js1hdjX8W1CR2895TvW16N56dXjb3pyd0W8wLKSR6lZ3mLW9dR0Z53vWbBZW34l02b7GlFS6W7TpKjr7w4vQQW324YM68CC5-0W8_VnqL2DS9V9N89w_03sSZ9WW8Cr4C21fz5s8W1L01pM3Cq1F2W5txSw26zXsCDW7j9QZL2XcvppW2P6Ts-7d-cLjW5bK4-L63WKlhW4cV3pf7bVBBpN1rFYPDgghxyW1VN4qn288D9TW3GQjx83L_vrKM_pnsSzv618N5xxjwgsNCtFN8-RY2z3WKz4V8Wxwj8k-Z0BW7YSGfk6Gq74dW3HFdWr6SmmVNW4SJpTr7vfLfDW3bvjnS1GSRMHW7_4vdp58hGtGW79f1PZ3MDNJtW5-KlSL3qRqbnVjGP3B2w_SRKf5xdYYR04 ) premiered its AI film The Cully Hill Boys in New York last month, the breakthrough wasn’t on the screen. It was in the contracts.¹

The film stars the licensed AI likenesses of real celebrities: UFC champion Israel Adesanya, MMA veteran Quinton “Rampage” Jackson, streamer N3on, and streetball athlete Matt Kiatipis.¹

Each one signed on: providing photos and voice recordings under agreements covering compensation, scope of use, and script approval.¹

Higgsfield built the film to showcase its flagship Cinema Studio 4.0 platform, and it scales.

The company made the film for about $2 million in four weeks. Higgsfield claims that comparable independent productions typically have a $20 million budget and a timeline of up to two years.¹

Here are the numbers fueling Cinema Studio 4.0:

- Est. $5.4 billion valuation, up roughly 4x in about eight months.²
- ~$700M ARR as of August, up from about $20M a year earlier.²
- 300M+ videos generated for 25M+ users.³
- $533M+ raised from investors including Accel and Goldman Sachs.⁴

There’s no guarantee that revenue, funding, or valuation will continue to grow for Higgsfield, or that the company will be profitable. See the risk disclosures on the offering page.

78407.subject: AVALANCHE AUGUST 2026 RECAP
78407.body:
View this post on the web at https://www.team1.blog/p/avalanche-august-2026-recap

August was the month Wall Street started showing up on Avalanche in earnest. Charles Schwab added AVAX for its 40 million brokerage accounts, Dinari brought 724 tokenized U.S. stocks including the full S&P 500 to Avalanche investors, and POSCO International completed a proof of concept for tokenizing global trade receivables on the network.
At the same time, Team1 officially launched in Korea. With Avalanche Summit NYC less than three weeks away, September is shaping up to be a major moment for the ecosystem.
Here’s everything that happened in August.
Want to keep up with the latest in the Avalanche ecosystem? Subscribe to the Team1 blog and get our updates in your inbox weekly.
Tokenized Assets Grow Nearly 8x in a Year:
Tokenized assets on Avalanche climbed from $242 million to $1.93 billion over the past year, with Securitize now accounting for more than half of that value. [Growth [ https://substack.com/redirect/5fc6043c-d884-4242-90b9-611b3d9b8308?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]]
Foundation Introduces Gross Chain Income:
The Avalanche Foundation published a new Gross Chain Income framework from Lead Economist Eric Lu, extending its Gross Chain Product work into a three-step model for measuring, capturing, and distributing value across the ecosystem. [GCI [ https://substack.com/redirect/92d16235-ee07-40f6-a010-1a719e9a302b?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]]
RWA Transfer Volume Jumps 360% in 30 Days:
Avalanche’s RWA ecosystem recorded $365.29 million in 30-day transfer volume, up 360.15% from the prior month, spanning tokenized funds, equities, treasuries, and private credit. [Volume [ https://substack.com/redirect/183ebb6c-4c8e-4af8-ad57-0c24db4d6fce?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]]
Team1 Korea Officially Launches:
Team1 Korea launched after onboarding more than 500 builders, 12 teams, 200-plus developers, and 80-plus founders, giving Korean talent a clearer path to build on Avalanche.
Team1 Chapters Stay Busy Across Five Continents:
Team1 chapters continued bringing Avalanche directly to local builders. August highlights included a builder workshop in Seoul focused on AI-agent payments, a meetup in Reggio Calabria, a Builder Connect at Oracle’s Bogotá offices, an L1 workshop in Türkiye, university activity in Vietnam, and multiple builder and community events across Brazil, India, Latin America, Nigeria and lots more.
New paths for funding and support opened up this month.
Team1 Opens Applications for ProtocolCamp Cohort 10:
Team1 called for builders to join ProtocolCamp Cohort 10, a 12-week program turning ideas into shipped products with travel covered and a kickoff during Korea Blockchain Week. [ProtocolCamp [ https://substack.com/redirect/484aea27-85f1-40c0-922a-43f8706045a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEW
